prompt: Illustration painted on a WOOD PANEL, visible wood grain showing through matte paint. SIMPLE and CALM: big flat shapes, generous empty space, only sparing line detail — NOT dense, NOT busy, NOT intricately hatched. Naive storybook charm with gentle whimsy. Strictly limited palette: pale bone-grey painted ground, FLAT solid black, white, and ONE accent of glowing BIOLUMINESCENT GREEN (foxfire — pale green-cyan light). The only inhabitants are SMALL ANIMAL-LIKE BEINGS rendered as simple solid black silhouettes, each with a distinctive CURLED SPIRAL FIDDLEHEAD EAR on either side of the head. Absolutely NO human figures, NO people. No text, no lettering, no runes, no glyphs. A cluster of five very small simple cabins sitting under two enormous fern fronds and one giant pine cone, drawn as big calm flat shapes with minimal detail. Every window and doorway is a small flat BIOLUMINESCENT GREEN rectangle. Two tiny black beings with curled spiral ears sit together on a doorstep; a third is a small green point of light far down the path. Flat black sky, pale bone ground, generous empty space.
